summary: English AI-interpretation (CP) template of Clinic H on the same front pages as T07: a full-page cover bitmap, the executive summary and recommendation forms, a discussion page of CP slots and fixed classifier sentences, then the master chapters extended with a scripted frequency-marker table, vigilance and microstates inside CP input sections. It ends with an appendix of questionnaire item lists and the template script.

fonts.families: theme fonts Trebuchet MS and Calibri; runs set to Calibri, Tahoma for complex script, Courier New in the script block, Helvetica, Candara Light and Cambria Math in a few runs

colours: light grey and very light grey table shading
light cyan cells in the evoked response summary table
dark blue and mid blue text in places
yellow highlight on two fixed classifier sentences
header: patient slots (last name, first name, birth date)
footer: company line (name of a partner company of the manufacturer)

cover as one bitmap that carries title, logo and contact data (cannot be themed, translated or checked)

footer as a floating text box

not_expressible.what: Recording parameters, montage, durations and norm comparison typed as clinic text

review_response.finding: pseudonymisation 0, 1, numbers 1: quoted template prose slipped through a 5-word check that ignored hyphens, text boxes and content controls
review_response.reason: Ran a 4-word check with hyphens split against all text of the raw docx (body, content controls, text boxes, headers, footers, alt texts, document properties); no run of template prose remains in T13.

review_response.finding: pseudonymisation 6: exact use counts let anyone with the export re-identify the template
review_response.reason: reports_per_year and share_pct come from usage_rounded.json.

review_response.finding: classify-2 3, completeness 0: the extractor skipped content controls, so covers and running headers were missing
review_response.reason: Model rebuilt from tpl_extract_v2 and checked against the raw XML. The running header sits in a content control and is e105. This template has no body content control.

review_response.finding: numbers 0, completeness 1: coverage counted only not_expressible elements while listed gaps sat in elements classed as covered
review_response.reason: Every element whose representation needs a schema change is now class not_expressible with a gap code, and every not_expressible entry names its elements.

review_response.reason: One rule: the table of contents and page references are not_expressible G5; language selectors, hidden lines and block markers are leave_out control_marker; the hand-ticked peak tables are not_expressible G6 (e85).
